role: L2 / P10「换真数据」第二数据集 · 对账真值（机器可复算）
as_of_note: 未来日期判定与清洗窗口上界 = 2026-11-19；冻结值，不随运行日漂移。
money_format: DECIMAL(16,2)：金额一律两位小数；本文件以保留两位小数的 JSON number 字面量输出（如 1136341.10），比对时按 Decimal 值比较。
why_float_column: fact_order.order_amount 物理类型与 dw.sql 相同仍是 FLOAT；所有金额聚合先逐值 CAST(x AS DECIMAL(16,2)) 再 SUM，避免 FLOAT 累加噪声。
provenance: 全部数值由 fixtures/dw-real.sql 真实导入 MySQL 8.0.46 后执行本文件中的 sql 得到，没有任何手算。
how_to_recompute: 1) 起一个临时 MySQL 8.0（验证时用 mysql:8.0 容器，监听 127.0.0.1:3310，库名随导入脚本创建为 dw）
3) 先执行 clean.clean_fact_sql 建 tmp_clean_fact 临时表；再执行各 check 的 sql（引用 tmp_clean_fact 的必须在同一会话）
5) 金额按 DECIMAL(16,2) 比较，日期按 yyyyMMdd 整数比较；机器批量比对见 README「验证（真跑）」

naive_sum_amount.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(order_amount AS DECIMAL(16,2))) AS DECIMAL(16,2)) FROM fact_order;

distinct_years.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date_id DIV 10000) FROM fact_order;

raw.note: naive_sum_amount 是「不洗不筛直接 SUM」的错数：重复行 +1 份、孤儿行、未来行都在里面，NULL 行被 SUM 跳过。

dirty_classes.name: order_amount 为 NULL
dirty_classes.effect: SUM 漏掉 2 行金额；COUNT(*) 又把它们算进订单数 → 金额与单数口径同时错位。

rows_with_null_amount.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order WHERE order_amount IS NULL;

dirty_classes.name: order_id 重复（1 对重复行）
dirty_classes.effect: naive SUM 把同一单金额算两次；COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) 会少算行数（去重会少）。

duplicate_order_id_groups.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM fact_order GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t;

duplicate_rows_involved.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c), 0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM fact_order GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t;

extra_duplicate_rows.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c - 1), 0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM fact_order GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t;

duplicate_order_id.sql: SELECT order_id FROM fact_order GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 1;

duplicate_row_amount.sql: SELECT CAST(CAST(order_amount AS DECIMAL(16,2)) AS DECIMAL(16,2)) FROM fact_order WHERE order_id = 'ORD20261119001' LIMIT 1;

dirty_classes.name: dim_region.region_name 带后缀脏值（华北区 / 华东区）
dirty_classes.effect: 按契约枚举值（华南/华东/西南/华北/华中）过滤或 JOIN 会漏掉 R002、R004 两区的订单 → 华东、华北销售额大幅少算。

dim_rows_with_dirty_name.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_region WHERE region_name LIKE '%区';

dirty_region_names.sql: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(region_name ORDER BY region_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM dim_region WHERE region_name LIKE '%区';

affected_fact_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = f.region_id WHERE r.region_name LIKE '%区';

contract_enum_filter_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = f.region_id WHERE f.order_amount IS NOT NULL AND r.region_name IN ('华南','华东','西南','华北','华中');

contract_enum_filter_sales.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(f.order_amount AS DECIMAL(16,2))) AS DECIMAL(16,2)) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = f.region_id WHERE f.order_amount IS NOT NULL AND r.region_name IN ('华南','华东','西南','华北','华中');

dirty_classes.name: fact_order.region_id 孤儿行（R099 不在 dim_region）
dirty_classes.detect: LEFT JOIN dim_region ... WHERE r.region_id IS NULL
dirty_classes.effect: 内连接会静默丢掉这 1 行金额；清洗规则必须显式剔孤儿，不能指望 JOIN 报错。

orphan_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order f LEFT JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = f.region_id WHERE r.region_id IS NULL;

orphan_region_id.sql: SELECT f.region_id FROM fact_order f LEFT JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = f.region_id WHERE r.region_id IS NULL LIMIT 1;

dirty_classes.name: 日期跨 2023–2026 且含 1 行未来日期（2026-12-15）
dirty_classes.effect: 时间过滤口径会变：不设上界就把未来单算进当期；写死演示集的 20250101–20250331 又只剩 1 个季度。

future_date_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order WHERE date_id > 20261119;

future_date.sql: SELECT date_id FROM fact_order WHERE date_id > 20261119 LIMIT 1;

additional_anomalies.name: dim_region 同名(province=北京市)两行不同 id（R004 / R007）
additional_anomalies.effect: 按 region_id 关联安全（1:1）；一旦按 province/region_name 这类自然键连接，北京市的订单会被匹配两次 → 行数与金额放大。

duplicate_province_groups.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT province FROM dim_region GROUP BY province HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t;

extra_dim_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT province) FROM dim_region;

province_join_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_clean_fact f JOIN dim_region d1 ON d1.region_id = f.region_id JOIN dim_region d2 ON d2.province = d1.province;

province_join_sales.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(f.order_amount) AS DECIMAL(16,2)) FROM tmp_clean_fact f JOIN dim_region d1 ON d1.region_id = f.region_id JOIN dim_region d2 ON d2.province = d1.province;

additional_anomalies.name: 金额带分（两位小数；dw.sql 是整数金额）
additional_anomalies.effect: 整数金额的直觉失效：必须按 DECIMAL(16,2) 处理，四舍五入/截断会让对账差几角几分。

rows_with_nonzero_cents.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order WHERE order_amount IS NOT NULL AND order_amount <> ROUND(order_amount, 0);

cleaning_rules.name: 去重：同一 order_id 只保留 1 行
cleaning_rules.sql: SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, product_id, date_id, region_id, order_quantity, order_amount FROM fact_order
cleaning_rules.why: D2：重复行为逐列相同，DISTINCT 即可；真实数据若列有差异需定保留规则。

cleaning_rules.name: 剔除金额缺失行
cleaning_rules.why: D1：无金额的订单不能计入销售额与有效单数。

cleaning_rules.name: 时间窗口上界 = AS-OF 2026-11-19
cleaning_rules.why: D5：未来单不算当期；AS-OF 用冻结值而非 CURDATE()，保证机器可复算。

cleaning_rules.name: 剔除孤儿地区行
cleaning_rules.sql: JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = d.region_id  -- INNER JOIN 即过滤
cleaning_rules.why: D4：region_id 不在 dim_region 的行不能参与地区对账。

cleaning_rules.name: 地区名归一化（去掉尾部“区”后缀）
cleaning_rules.why: D3：把 华北区→华北、华东区→华东，回到契约枚举值。

cleaning_rules.name: 地区维度只按 region_id 关联
cleaning_rules.sql: -- 只 JOIN ON r.region_id = f.region_id；不要按 province / region_name 关联
cleaning_rules.why: D6：按自然键关联会被同名维度行放大。

cleaning_rules.name: 金额按 DECIMAL 聚合
cleaning_rules.sql: CAST(order_amount AS DECIMAL(16,2)) 后再 SUM
cleaning_rules.why: 金额带分 + FLOAT 物理类型；输出两位小数。

cleaning_rules.name: 单数用去重后的行数
cleaning_rules.why: 去重后 COUNT(*) 与 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) 应相等（都是 405）；两者不等说明清洗没做干净。

clean.clean_fact_sql:
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_clean_fact AS
WITH dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, product_id, date_id, region_id, order_quantity, order_amount
    FROM fact_order
),
clean AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, d.date_id, d.region_id, d.order_quantity,
           CAST(d.order_amount AS DECIMAL(16,2)) AS order_amount,
           TRIM(TRAILING '区' FROM r.region_name) AS region_name
    FROM dedup d
    JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = d.region_id
    WHERE d.order_amount IS NOT NULL
      AND d.date_id <= 20261119
)
SELECT * FROM clean
clean.recipe: 先执行 clean_fact_sql 建立 tmp_clean_fact，再执行本节的 sql（后者引用 tmp_clean_fact，需同一连接会话）。

total_sales.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(order_amount) AS DECIMAL(16,2)) FROM tmp_clean_fact;

north_china_orders.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM tmp_clean_fact WHERE region_name = '华北';

north_china_sales.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(order_amount) AS DECIMAL(16,2)) FROM tmp_clean_fact WHERE region_name = '华北';

by_region.sql: SELECT region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, CAST(SUM(order_amount) AS DECIMAL(16,2)) AS sales FROM tmp_clean_fact GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY region_name;
